data.one_liner: Extracts direct media links from supported URLs for streaming or downloading
data.what_it_does: The package parses a given URL from supported sites and returns metadata such as title, thumbnail, duration and a list of available direct links with quality and type. It can be used to stream or download media directly.
use_when: You need to fetch direct media URLs from popular video or media hosting sites
You want to avoid using the sites’ own players and stream/download directly in your app
avoid_when: You only need to display the original site’s player
You need advanced download management or offline caching
strengths: Supports many popular sites (Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, Vimeo, etc.)
Provides metadata (title, thumbnail, duration) along with direct links
Simple API with a single `check` method
weaknesses: No built‑in download manager or progress tracking
Limited to the sites listed in the package
No official support for non‑media sites
